<section class="hero">
  <span class="eyebrow">Centre for Genomic Regulation · Barcelona</span>
  <h1>We build <em>generative</em> models <br class="br-wide">of life&rsquo;s data across scales.</h1>
  <p>In our research group we combine deep learning and Bayesian statistics to model biological data, from protein sequences to single cells and whole populations across species. Our work has a focus on real-world impact, in disease diagnosis and risk prediction, therapeutic discovery and conservation genomics, and we develop the theory and architectures that will enable the next generation of models.</p>
  <a class="hiring" href="join.html#positions"><span class="dot"></span>We're hiring three postdocs: virtual cells, conservation genomics and rare disease diagnosis <span class="arr">&rarr;</span></a>
